1.consolidated_definition: Pieza musical bailable originalmente circunscrita a una frase repetida de 8 compases, llamada paseo, y de dos partes más de 8 o de 16 compases repetidos.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Dance piece originally confined to a repeated phrase of 8 measures, called paseo, and two parts of 8 or 16 measures repeated.
